Role: UXR
Industry: Design
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: A lot of features like advanced segmentation, data-driven attribution, and customizable funnels let me better understand users' needs and problems
Cons: i don't remember to mention it and i think it is good enough

Role: Digital Solutions Lead
Industry: Marketing and Advertising
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: I love how the tool allows you to track and discover so many unique insights about your customers and visitors to your website
Cons: I don't like the challenges GA 360 gives people when they want to make a connection to social media channels like Meta and TikTok
Comments: Overall, it is and remains a valuable tool that is essential to understanding the performance of your website and business

Role: Director and Marketing Consultant
Industry: Marketing and Advertising
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: Good reporting, especially gets more important in high-traffic sites where Google Analytics performed better
Cons: The UX, interface, and dashboard are not friendly. Hard to understand, make selections and not time-efficient

Role: Marketing Designer
Industry: Broadcast Media
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: I used a free trial
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Las 200 métricas personalizadas disponibles generan un flujo de información perfecto, muchísima calidad de datos para usar en la publicidad y marketing de la empresa, puedes sesgar casi hasta el infinito con ellas.
Cons: Muy escalable en todo, menos en el precio. Sé que está enfocado a grandes empresas, pero tiene funciones interesantes y hemos querido probarlas, pero tendremos que dejar de tenerlo por el precio, no le podemos sacar rendimiento.
Reasons for choosing: Quisimos probar la versión avanzada de Google Analytics.

Role: Marketing Manager
Industry: Consumer Goods
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: It allows us to track the user journey, what marketing efforts are paying off, high performance pages and even ad hoc requests. It is impossible to analyse a website performance without google analytics
Cons: The mobile app has limited features compared to the web version.
Comments: It has been great. It has given us a roadmap of where we can improve and what is performing well.

Role: B to B Strategy Consulting
Industry: Information Services
Company size: 501-1,000 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Having used the free version of Google Analytics before, using the tool has been smooth for me. Launching and integration was a success and I take pride to the much I have achieved using this great software. Getting unsampled results and freely export custom tables and roll-up reports. With Google Analytics 360, every data makes sense and can lead to outstanding results and achieve optimization on the long run.
Cons: I have transitioned from the free version and I surely appreciate the changes. Everything is cool.
Comments: Great support team and reliable results. Good job.

Role: Founder
Industry: Professional Training & Coaching
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: The most satisfying thing here is how easy it is to work with Google Analytics 360. In a few steps, I was able to launch the tool in my small organization and easily integrate it with a few softwares. Ever since I have the right insight towards customer handling and what they need in the market. It is a whole great deal to enjoy. Be sure to steal the idea.
Cons: When my clients are satisfied, my case is closed and I concentrate on maintaining the satisfaction. This tool has done it and I comfortably concentrate on other matters outside work. No challenges.
Comments: Reliable indicators for reports makes things professional and updated. More benefits.

Role: Assistant Accountant
Industry: Financial Services
Company size: 501-1,000 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: It is unbelievable how this software achieves so much under one casing yet so perfect. I have enjoyed every bit of the dashboard customization process. It makes things easier and quite presentable. Cheers to more achievements with Google Analytics 360.
Cons: Perfect. The customer service team is quite committed to assisting users. I hope they will keep the fire burning for the future generations.
Comments: Finding Google Analytics 360 is getting the best hack.

Role: IT Manager
Industry: Higher Education
Company size: 5,001-10,000 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Very easy to use, it is Google after all.The price is very fair, and also came with a Google support that is excellent, especially when training new employees.Employees as a whole have found this product easier to learn and use for assessment and tracking
Cons: No complaints except there are competitors who are cheaper but again you get what you pay for.
Comments: Excellent for helping us pursue more efficient ways of employee training and monitoring of several student and financial processes I. Higher education

Role: IT Admin
Industry: Automotive
Company size: Self-employed
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Google Analytics 360 is one of the services provided by Google free of charge to all individual and professional users. It is one of the best services provided by a powerful company like Google. Thanks to its strong infrastructure, it produces strong results in reporting, analysis and data control.Its design has been modernized with the users in mind, it has all the tools and plugins you may need, and it has a structure that brings fast results. It provides powerful presentations that can analyze the user behaviors you will need especially on your websites, provide traffic control, and analyze data up to demographic structure.
Cons: Integration takes a long time at first. However, after making the necessary configuration of the connections, it provides a much easier and simpler management. There is nothing that we can report as a negative or a [truncated]

Role: Innovation lead
Industry: Information Technology and Services
Company size: 10,001+ employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 3
Pros: Dashboards accessible for thousands of employees without affection of the raw data
Cons: Pretty difficult to learn without a course or a capacitation
Comments: I started using extracting data from a worldwide company and end up finding all the features to companies up to 100.000 employees

Role: Pm
Industry: Machinery
Company size: 10,001+ employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: I really appreciate the flexibility in data model links and possibility to create different KPIs and drill down into visuals
Cons: Data model creation is not easy, it requires a deep understanding of the database structure in order to create correct KPI
Comments: Overall it is the best tool for shopfloor live dashboard linked to manufacturing execution system and for plant/prod line managers KPI tracking

Role: Analista de TI
Industry: Textiles
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Fácil utilização, excelentes modelos, como é um produto muito utilizado é de fácil suporte. Implantação descomplicada como qualquer produto da Microsoft
Cons: Constantes atualizações, embora necessária algumas acabam impactando no funcionamento de personalizações.
Reasons for switching: Facilidade no suporte dos serviços da Microsoft
Switched from: Rocket Matter

Role: Digital Consultant
Industry: Automotive
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 3
Pros: Power BI has a user-friendly interface and a wide range of data connectivity options, making it easy to create insightful visualizations.
Cons: It has a steep learning curve for advanced features and can experience performance issues with larger datasets.
Comments: Overall, it’s a powerful and flexible tool for data visualization and analysis, particularly favored for its integration with other Microsoft products.

Role: coordenador
Industry: Mechanical or Industrial Engineering
Company size: 5,001-10,000 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I really like the graphics and automatic updates
Cons: when we make filters for the graphs it deconfigures everything
Comments: application very used in my day to day in the company

Role: Financial Controller
Industry: Financial Services
Company size: 10,001+ employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 3
Pros: It offers you a lot of diversification opportunities regarding reporting.
Cons: Sometimes you can get bogged down in unnecessary details.
Comments: As a proven company, Microsoft's product is very useful and innovative. In addition, you can make the reports you want to prepare in the company much more effective.

Role: Data Engineer
Industry: Consumer Goods
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: One of the industry-leading reporting tools in the current market. Relatively easy to generate reports using the drag and drop method. Can be connected with large DBs using connection strings in DirectQuery method helping in live tracking . Fast: large sets of data from different tables can be combined without much operational lag. For a multi employee company, the Power BI portal is really helpful as the user access and permissions are easy to manage.
Cons: The Power BI license for each user is comparatively not cheap. Sometimes the gateway to the specific database makes this a little complex. Premium features need high tier licensing. eventhough report creation is simpler, The DB connectivity , Gateway management, DAX etc. requires techincal expertise.
Comments: overall ,for an enterprise environment, PowerBI can add value to a company as [truncated]

Role: IT
Industry: Telecommunications
Company size: 1,001-5,000 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 3
Pros: Interfaccia intuitiva con dashboard interattive e offre un'ambia compatibilità con diverse fonti di dati.
Cons: La versione gratuita ha molte limitazioni e le prestazioni degradano con dataset grandi.
Comments: Strumento molto utile e putente per chi lavora con i dati.

Role: Engenheiro
Industry: Construction
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: Less than 6 months
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: Software novo para mim com um potencial enorme. Com as informações que introduzo no sistema consigo fazer uma recolha significativa de indicadores importantes para o meu dia-a-dia de trabalho.
Cons: Poderiam melhorar a conectividade com outros sistemas operativos da concorrência.
Comments: Este software pode ser incluído do Microsoft 365 que vai facilitar a sua integração da empresa.

Role: Sr. Auditor
Industry: Construction
Company size: 10,001+ employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: The ease and flexibility in creating various dashboards. The multifunctional on creating the impact or show the numbers in the world map for a global company is absolutely great.
Cons: I think there can be some more in-built analytical tools that would use the uploaded table to run some analytics for us. Although I have heard co-pilot is a new tool. I have not had a chance to use it yet.
